title: Build comprehensive game library platform with 500+ titles

requirements.text: Create backend data model for games with fields: id, title, franchise, releaseYear, developer, genre, platform, sport, description, rating, coverImage, tags, trending, isNew, playCount

quotes: Each game must include: id, title, franchise, releaseYear, developer, genre, platform, sport (if applicable), description, rating, coverImage, tags

acceptanceCriteria: Game type includes all specified fields
Rating field supports numerical values
Sport field is optional and supports null values
Tags field supports array of strings

requirements.text: Implement backend CRUD operations for games: create game, update game, delete game, get game by id, list all games with pagination, query games by filters (genre, year, franchise, sport, search term)

quotes: Filter by genre, year, franchise, sport

acceptanceCriteria: Create game endpoint accepts all game fields
Update game endpoint allows partial updates
Delete game endpoint removes game by id
Query endpoint supports multiple simultaneous filters
List endpoint returns paginated results
Search term filters by title, description, and tags

requirements.text: Seed backend with initial game dataset of 500+ games including: 30 Action games (Shadow Strike, Bullet Storm Arena, Cyber Ninja, etc.), 30 Puzzle games (Brain Twist, Logic Master, Tile Connect, etc.), 30 Racing games (Nitro Speed, Drift King, Street Racer Pro, etc.), 30 Sports games (Soccer Pro 2026, Basketball Legends, Street Football, etc.), 30 RPG games (Dragon Realm, Mystic Quest, Shadow Kingdom, etc.), additional categories (Simulation, Strategy, Horror, Multiplayer, Arcade, Idle, Adventure, Survival, Sandbox, Platformer) with 30 games each, all NBA 2K editions (1999-present), all NBA Live editions, all Madden NFL editions (1988-present), all NCAA Football editions, all FIFA editions (1993-2023), EA Sports FC editions, Pro Evolution Soccer editions, major franchises: Fortnite, Minecraft, Roblox, Grand Theft Auto series, Call of Duty series, Halo series, The Legend of Zelda series, Super Mario series, God of War series, Elden Ring, Apex Legends, Valorant, Rocket League, Overwatch, League of Legends, Counter-Strike, Red Dead Redemption series, Among Us, Terraria, The Sims 4

quotes: Include every title from franchises such as: Fortnite, Minecraft, Roblox, Grand Theft Auto (all titles)
Include every edition from: NBA 2K (1999–present), NBA Live (all editions)
Include every edition from: Madden NFL (1988–present)

acceptanceCriteria: At least 500 unique games exist in the database
All listed game titles are included
All major franchise series have multiple editions
Sports games include yearly editions spanning specified date ranges
Each game has complete metadata (title, year, developer, genre, etc.)
Games are properly categorized by genre

requirements.text: Create backend user authentication system with Internet Identity integration supporting user registration, login, and session management
acceptanceCriteria: Users can authenticate using Internet Identity
User sessions persist across page reloads
User profile stores unique identifier

requirements.text: Implement backend user profile system with favorites list, recently played games tracking, and play count tracking per game
acceptanceCriteria: Users can add games to favorites list
Users can remove games from favorites
Users can retrieve their favorites list
Recently played tracks last 20 games played by user with timestamps
Play count increments when user plays a game

requirements.text: Create backend rating system allowing users to rate games on a scale (1-5 stars) and calculate average ratings per game
acceptanceCriteria: Users can submit one rating per game
Ratings are stored with user id and game id
Average rating is calculated and stored per game
Users can update their existing rating
Get game endpoint returns average rating and total rating count

requirements.text: Implement backend comments system for games allowing users to post, edit, and delete comments with timestamps
acceptanceCriteria: Users can post comments on game detail pages
Comments include user id, game id, text, and timestamp
Users can edit their own comments
Users can delete their own comments
Comments are returned in reverse chronological order

requirements.text: Create backend leaderboard system tracking top players by total play count across all games
acceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard aggregates total plays per user
Leaderboard returns top 100 users ranked by play count
Leaderboard data updates in real-time as users play games

requirements.text: Implement backend admin authorization system with admin role assignment and admin-only endpoints for game management
acceptanceCriteria: Admin role can be assigned to user principals
Only admins can create, update, or delete games
Non-admin users receive authorization errors when accessing admin endpoints

requirements.text: Create homepage with hero banner section featuring prominent heading and call-to-action
acceptanceCriteria: Hero banner displays at top of homepage
Hero banner includes heading text
Hero banner includes call-to-action button
Hero banner uses dark background with neon accent colors

requirements.text: Build search bar component with live filtering that filters games in real-time as user types, searching across title, description, and tags
acceptanceCriteria: Search input appears prominently on homepage
Search results update immediately as user types
Search matches game titles, descriptions, and tags
Search results display below search bar
Empty search shows all games

requirements.text: Create category filter system with dropdown or checkbox filters for genre, year, franchise, and sport that can be combined with search

quotes: Filter by genre, year, franchise, sport

acceptanceCriteria: Genre filter shows all available genres
Year filter allows selection of release year range
Franchise filter lists major franchises
Sport filter shows sports categories
Multiple filters can be active simultaneously
Filters combine with search results
Clear filters button resets all selections

acceptanceCriteria: Trending section shows games with highest recent play counts
New Releases section shows games sorted by release date (newest first)
Popular section shows games with highest all-time play counts

acceptanceCriteria: Thumbnail displays game cover image
Title appears below or overlaid on image
Genre tag displays on thumbnail
Hover triggers scale-up animation
Hover adds neon glow effect around thumbnail

requirements.text: Build game detail page component displaying game title, cover image, release year, developer, platform, full description, average rating with star display, play button, comments section, and related games carousel

acceptanceCriteria: Login button appears in header when not authenticated

acceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard page accessible from main navigation

acceptanceCriteria: Admin dashboard route protected and only accessible to admins

requirements.text: Add favorite toggle button on game detail page and game thumbnails allowing users to add/remove games from favorites with heart icon animation

Heart icon displays on game thumbnail cards

Clicking toggles favorite status
Animation plays when toggling favorite

requirements.text: Implement dark mode theme with neon accent colors throughout the application using dark backgrounds (dark gray or black) and neon colors (cyan, magenta, electric blue, or lime green) for accents, buttons, and highlights

requirements.text: Optimize frontend performance with lazy loading for game thumbnails, pagination for game lists (50 games per page), and React Query caching for API responses

Loading states display during data fetches
Infinite scroll or pagination controls implemented for game lists

requirements.text: Implement SEO optimization with semantic HTML, descriptive page titles per route, meta descriptions, and proper heading hierarchy

Semantic HTML5 elements used (header, nav, main, section, article, footer)

requirements.text: Create franchise grouping pages showing all games belonging to a specific franchise (e.g., all Call of Duty titles, all NBA 2K editions) with franchise header and game list
acceptanceCriteria: Franchise pages accessible via /franchise/:name route
Page displays franchise name as heading

Games sorted by release year (newest first)

requirements.text: Establish a bold, energetic visual design direction with neon cyberpunk aesthetics: use angular geometric shapes, gradient overlays on images, glowing borders on interactive elements, and high-contrast typography that evokes a competitive esports atmosphere
acceptanceCriteria: Design uses angular geometric shapes in UI elements
Images have gradient overlays or filters
Interactive elements have glowing border effects

Overall aesthetic resembles professional esports platforms

constraints: Backend must use single-actor Motoko architecture with all logic in main actor

Do not edit immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Authentication must use Internet Identity only, no third-party auth providers
Do not implement real-time features like WebSockets or real-time chat
Do not integrate external AI services like OpenAI or Anthropic
Do not use external databases; all data persists in Motoko actor stable variables
nonGoals: Integration with social media APIs like Twitter or Facebook
Mobile app development (React Native or Flutter)
Video streaming or gameplay recording features
Multiplayer game functionality or matchmaking systems
External payment processing beyond basic Stripe integration
